correctness.rationale: One indices 2^j-1 give successive unique gaps 1,2,4,... . For power gap g=2^j, the two-1 block H_g=10^(g−1)1 occurs uniquely with exactly λ_1=0 or λ_g=g/2−1 preceding zeros and 2g−1 following zeros. Consequently absent H_g for nonpowers and minimal padding obstructions L_g,R_g for powers plus 111. Conversely avoidance forces every successive gap power-of-two and adjacent gaps e=2d (else forbidden R_d if too big or L_e/111 if too small). Left/right padding then fits the unique c occurrence; hence the listed basis is complete for the infinite word. Enumerating lengths yields F(z)=z²/(1−z)−∑z^(2^j+1)+2z³+2∑z^(3·2^j+1). An independent substring set comparison on the first 16384 symbols checked lengths 1..30 (34 predicted absent words) and full short-factor avoidance to length14. No finite-prefix extrapolation is claimed.
